mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS songId, s.name AS songName, s.album AS album, s.lyric AS lyric, s.duration AS duration, s.cover_url AS songCoverUrl, s.audio_url AS audioUrl, s.release_time AS releaseTime, a.name AS artistName FROM tb_song s LEFT JOIN tb_artist a ON s.artist_id = a.id WHERE s.id = #{songId}

SELECT s.id AS songId, s.name AS songName, s.album, s.duration, s.cover_url AS coverUrl, s.audio_url AS audioUrl, s.release_time AS releaseTime, a.name AS artistName FROM tb_user_favorite f JOIN tb_song s ON s.id = f.song_id LEFT JOIN tb_artist a ON a.id = s.artist_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.type = 0
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{songName}, '%')
AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{artistName}, '%')
AND s.album LIKE CONCAT('%', #{album}, '%')
ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT g.style_id FROM tb_genre g WHERE g.song_id IN
#{item}
